system.terrain: Crab: Cavern, Ruins. Black Widow, Tarantella: Ruins. Woods.
system.monsterType: Lowlife (Rare). Giant spiders are simply huge versions of normal spider species. All giant spiders can be dangerous, and many are poisonous. All are carnivores, either trapping their prey in webs or jumping at victims by surprise. However, they are rarely intelligent, and will often flee from fire. Three examples of giant spiders are given here. Crab Spider: This is a 5' long spider with a chameleonlike ability to blend into its surroundings, surprising on a roll of 1-4 (on 1d6). It clings to walls or ceilings and drops onto its prey. After the first attack, it can be seen and attacked normally. Any victim of its bite must make a saving throw vs. poison or die in 1d4 turns. However, the poison is weak, and the victim gains a + 2 bonus to the saving throw roll.
